company.name: Wonderful
company.shortDescription: Wonderful develops an enterprise AI platform that helps organizations build, deploy, manage, and improve AI agents and applications.
company.description: Wonderful develops an enterprise AI platform that helps organizations build, deploy, manage, and improve AI agents and applications for business workflows. Its platform supports multiple AI models, data sources, communication channels, and use cases, allowing agents to operate across customer service, employee support, and back-office processes. Wonderful provides tools for agent development, reusable skills, evaluations, guardrails, knowledge integration, monitoring, and governance. The company also offers AI infrastructure through its AI Gateway, which manages model access, permissions, usage, costs, and routing across an organization’s AI stack. Its services include deployment support and strategic guidance for applying AI to workflows in sectors such as banking, telecommunications, healthcare, retail, utilities, and insurance.
